note: Batch 1 = the 29 program exercises not yet rendered. Motion for each is in motion/<id>.json (same format as the four pilots). Primary = red #d9392c, secondary = amber #f0a030, everything else grey. Muscle names are plain words; map them to the closest muscles modelled in Blender and tell us which names have no match.

exercises.equipment: Adjustable bench at about 30 degrees, two hex dumbbells
exercises.technique: Back on the incline pad, feet planted; dumbbells lower to chest level with elbows about 45 degrees from the torso and press up over the upper chest; hands hold the dumbbell handles.

exercises.equipment: Seated chest press machine: padded back, two handles at chest height on lever arms
exercises.camera: front three-quarter view from the side the arms move toward
exercises.technique: Back against the pad, handles at mid-chest, forearms roughly horizontal; arms press forward to near lockout and return slowly; hands on handles, feet flat.

exercises.equipment: Two high pulleys with D-handles, standing in the middle
exercises.technique: Slight forward lean, soft elbows; handles sweep from wide and high to together in front of the lower chest; hands stay on the handles, cables run to the pulleys.

exercises.equipment: Upright bench with back pad, two hex dumbbells
exercises.technique: Seated with back on pad, feet flat; dumbbells start at shoulder height, press overhead to near lockout, lower to ear level; wrists stacked over elbows.

exercises.equipment: Low pulley with a single D-handle, standing sideways to the stack
exercises.technique: Handle in the far-side hand across the body, arm lifts out to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend, then lowers; no body swing; cable runs from low pulley to the hand.

exercises.equipment: Two hex dumbbells, standing
exercises.technique: Standing tall, arms lift out to the sides to shoulder height with soft elbows, then lower under control; no swinging.

exercises.equipment: Standing lateral raise machine: lever arms with pads on the upper arms
exercises.technique: Standing against the support, upper arms against the pads, arms lift out to shoulder height and lower; the lever arms move with the arms.

exercises.equipment: Two hex dumbbells, standing
exercises.technique: Standing tall, arms lift straight in front to shoulder height with a slight elbow bend, then lower; no leaning back.

exercises.equipment: Pec deck machine used backwards: seated facing the pad, handles at shoulder height
exercises.technique: Chest on the pad, arms start in front and sweep out and back to shoulder line with soft elbows, then return; hands on the handles.

exercises.equipment: High pulley with a rope, standing facing away, overhead extension
exercises.technique: Rope behind the head, elbows pointing up and close to the head; forearms extend forward and up to full lockout, then return behind the head; upper arms stay still.

exercises.equipment: High pulley with a straight bar attachment, standing
exercises.technique: Elbows pinned to the sides; the bar goes from chest height down to full lockout at the thighs and returns to chest height; hands on the bar.

exercises.equipment: High pulley with a rope attachment, standing
exercises.technique: Elbows pinned to the sides; the rope is pulled down to full extension with the ends splitting apart at the bottom, then returns to chest height.

exercises.equipment: Lat pulldown station: seat, thigh pad, high pulley with a wide bar
exercises.technique: Seated with thighs under the pad, wide overhand grip; the bar pulls to the upper chest with the chest up and elbows driving down, then rises slowly to full stretch.

exercises.equipment: High pulley with a single D-handle, seated or kneeling
exercises.technique: One arm pulls the handle down toward the shoulder with the elbow driving to the hip, then returns to a full stretch.

exercises.equipment: Seated cable row station: seat, foot plate, low pulley with a V-handle
exercises.technique: Feet on the plate, knees soft, torso upright; handle is pulled to the lower ribs with shoulder blades squeezing, then returns to full stretch without rounding the back.

exercises.equipment: Seated pullover machine: seat, lever arm with elbow pads or handles overhead
exercises.technique: Seated back against the pad, arms start overhead and the lever sweeps down toward the hips, then returns overhead.

exercises.equipment: Plate-loaded T-bar row: bar anchored at one end with a V-handle near the plates
exercises.technique: Hinged forward with a flat back, knees soft; the handle is pulled to the lower chest and lowered to full stretch; feet planted either side of the bar.

exercises.equipment: Plate-loaded iso-lateral low row: chest pad, two independent lever arms with handles
exercises.technique: Chest against the pad, handles pulled back to the ribs with elbows back, then returned to a full stretch; hands on the handles.

exercises.equipment: Shrug machine: two handles at the sides or a bar at hip height, standing
exercises.technique: Standing tall, shoulders rise straight up toward the ears and lower; arms stay straight; hands hold the handles.

exercises.equipment: Preacher-style seated curl machine: arm pad and handles
exercises.technique: Upper arms on the pad, curl the handles up toward the shoulders and lower to nearly straight; hands on the handles.

exercises.equipment: Low pulley with a straight or EZ bar, standing
exercises.technique: Elbows at the sides, bar curls from the thighs up to shoulder height and lowers under control; cable runs to the low pulley.

exercises.equipment: Hack squat machine: angled sled, back pad, shoulder pads, foot platform
exercises.technique: Back on the pad, feet on the platform about shoulder width; knees bend to about 90 degrees or lower and press back up; heels stay down.

exercises.equipment: Smith machine: barbell on vertical rails, standing
exercises.technique: Bar on the upper back, feet slightly in front of the bar; squat to thighs parallel and stand; the bar moves only straight up and down.

exercises.equipment: Leg extension machine: seat, back pad, shin pad on a lever
exercises.technique: Seated with back on the pad, shin pad above the ankles; legs extend to near straight and lower under control; hips stay down.

exercises.equipment: Lying leg curl machine: face-down pad, ankle pad on a lever
exercises.technique: Lying face down, ankle pad above the heels; heels curl toward the glutes and return to nearly straight; hips stay on the pad.

exercises.equipment: Hip adductor machine: seat, back pad, leg pads on the inner thighs
exercises.technique: Seated, legs start wide against the pads and squeeze together, then open slowly; back on the pad.

exercises.equipment: Hip abductor machine: seat, back pad, leg pads on the outer thighs
exercises.technique: Seated, legs start together against the pads and push outward, then return slowly; back on the pad.

exercises.equipment: Standing calf raise machine: shoulder pads, foot platform
exercises.technique: Shoulders under the pads, balls of the feet on the platform; heels drop to a full stretch then rise high on the toes.

exercises.equipment: Leg press machine: seat, sled, foot platform, calf press with toes on the lower edge
exercises.technique: Seated, legs nearly straight, balls of the feet on the lower edge of the platform; the platform moves by ankle flexion only, with a full stretch and a high toe push.

exercises.equipment: Seated ab crunch machine: seat, chest pad or handles, foot rollers
exercises.technique: Seated, handles or pad at the chest; the torso curls forward and down by the abs, then returns slowly; hips stay on the seat.

exercises.equipment: Treadmill at a visible incline with side rails, belt moving
exercises.technique: Walking tall on the belt with a visible incline, opposite arm and leg swing, hands light on or near the rails; a six-step loop with no foot sliding relative to the belt.
